intent: Default preference for future manually authored DOHYEON KR Instagram reels; not yet automatically applied by the repository's automated shorts pipeline.

visual.composition: Reference from authority/responsibility pilot: header and thin rule; large upper dither object; divider; independent lower headline and short explanation; unobtrusive footer.
visual.dither: Dynamic 8x8 Bayer ordered dithering, recomputed from time-varying continuous-tone source at render time; never treat moving pre-dithered art as the primary effect.
visual.chartRule: Keep graph labels separate from numeric glyphs and plot fill; use non-overlapping box measured via browser.

dynamicDither.requirement: required for primary dither hero/meaningful numeric and graph scenes
dynamicDither.temporalMode: per-frame render-time quantization; render(timeSeconds) must be seekable and deterministic
dynamicDither.source: continuous-tone geometry plus meaningful animated luminance/alpha gradients, lighting and shadows
pipeline: generate continuous-tone shape/gradient/light at timeline time t
apply final spatial transform and sample in output/screen-space grid
compute Bayer 8x8 threshold per sample/pixel on current frame
composite sharp Korean body text, small labels, captions and ticks afterward
dynamicDither.spatialPattern: screen-space anchored ordered matrix; consistent cell size and pixel alignment across frames
avoid: pre-dithered PNG/SVG moved, cropped or scaled as the only effect
static CSS dot pattern masked into shape without per-frame recomputation
random frame-to-frame noise, flashing or jitter that does not follow luminance
flat solid objects with no meaningful gradient or light change
dynamicDither.gradientGuidance: Prefer directional/radial light gradients, animated highlights, soft alpha transitions, evolving shadows and meaningful brightness ramps. This is functional tonal data, not decorative UI gradients.
dynamicDither.exception: Cropping may be used for composition, but never substitutes for per-frame re-dithering.

narration.instruction: Use this exact voice ID for new reels when available within the connected HeyGen account's quota, unless the user requests another voice. Free-tier access is daily/availability limited, not perpetual unlimited usage.
narration.fallback: Do not silently change voice or incur paid charges if the free tier is exhausted. Prefer a user-approved locally runnable/free Korean TTS, and label the change.
narration.delivery: Measured speech WAV/PCM source preferred; one combined MP4 with actual narration and soft original ambient sound.

quality.verify: ffprobe streams/duration, decode and listen beginning/middle/end

writing.narrationStyle: Natural Korean ~합니다/~입니다, informative and observational; preserve author's experience, avoid generic motivational voice.
writing.instagramCaptionStyle: Explanatory practical caption (설명형), rather than merely restating autobiography or the full narration. Explain the technique, small actionable example, use cases, limits and a few relevant hashtags.
writing.cover: Question hook, not an answer-first spoiler.
writing.narrative: Concrete lived problem → reason vague estimation is costly → yes/no binary comparisons → choose stopping resolution → real-world use

qualityGate: multiple snapshots including all numeric steps and first/last frames
every key glyph and chart label inside measured safe bounds with no collisions
dynamic dithering proof: compare frames with changing gradient/light and confirm dot density/distribution recomputes, not only transformed static pattern
deterministic seek test: same timestamp produces identical dither frame
verify no random flicker and crisp Korean labels after dither pass
